about: A walk over the real floor of whatever project the server opens (this repository by default) that sends nothing to any agent. Columns are picked by what they carry (`with`) and by harness (`provider`), never by title; folders open through their path strips. Every part that needs something the live floor may not show (a parent with folded children, a stub, a Codex stub, a Claude Code column that has spoken, a compaction stratum) runs under an `if` and is skipped, with the reason logged, when the floor has none; a target the floor has put off screen is dragged into view first (`reveal`), and a hover the floor slides away is re-aimed (`reaim`). Covers: the floor, the git lane labels (none overprinting at the fitted zoom, smaller after a wheel zoom-out), the focus chain (a parent with folded children focused unfolded: its finished children as stubs in a row, no trace labels, one notch, no lines to them; a finished child's hover says handed back; a second click and the ≡ toggle open its timeline, Esc folds it back; the family marked by a platform in the parent's colour with its count at the end; a child focused from the row goes straight to its timeline with none of its siblings seated and no family lines, a message to it is refused and moves to its parent; the parent's · N children hovered), a childless column focused straight into its timeline, an inactive stub's hover (skipped by an `if` when the live floor does not show one), a closed folder's lane (agent-ide/ closed, the rail rewound to a moment with columns in it: the box a tile deep and wider, strips within their desks, a strip's full path on hover, the folder opened onto its inner lanes), a path strip, a focused Codex column with its labels near it and the rest dimmed, its ghost and readout, an opened label, its chat (labels hidden while it is open), the reasoning as one folded pill per turn (no thought switch), the chat's top and bottom bars, the command dropdown and the /status chip, the chat window moved by its title row (kept through a resize, a close and a reopen) and its resize grip, a focused Claude Code column with its labels and its chat (watch-only unless the Claude Code bridge is set up; nothing is sent), a switch to another column's chat (skipped when the moved chat window covers every stub), Esc clearing the dim, the rail rewound and back, the folder button, then a scratch project (--var folder=<a scratch folder with README.md>) where README.md is opened, the sheet moved by its title row (kept through a resize, a close and a reopen) and resized, edited and saved. It never saves into the repository. Its attention steps (after the first screenshot) click an agent that shows an error or a finished mark, on its column and then on its mini-map row (the latter only with ?minimap=inline), and check the mark is gone and stays gone over two canvas polls; with no such mark on the floor they are skipped.

actions.log: attention (2026-11-09: clicking the agent must remove the error mark): an agent on the list as failed or as finished is found by its row in the agent tree (tree-row:<column>:failed or :finished; the For you list went), then clicked the way a person does, on its column (a parent's column holds the marks of the subagents folded into it), then a mark on a mini-map row is clicked there; the entry goes at once and stays gone over the next two canvas polls. Where the floor lists no such agent at that moment the steps are skipped (logged), not failed. Screenshots before and after the first click.

actions.log: floor pack (2026-11-09: as little empty space as possible): pages, open folders and closed boxes packed by the skyline rule in name order leave at most a quarter of the floor empty (0.65 on the old shelf rows, 0.17 packed, on this repository), and no folder moves more than 4 floor units at any layout over 4 s of a floor nobody touches

git: the three most recently modified branches and this floor's, the newest nearest the floor, labels "branch · last modified" (no file count), lanes far enough apart to click
crowding: finished subagents fold into their parent as tabs; only running, focused and hovered columns print a readout and name; a readout stays by its own cap unless it stands in a same-lane stack

group stacks (2026-11-09: close columns are grouped): at the fitted view, columns that stand close on one lane share one stacked label beside the group, leftmost on top, each line its context number and its name; the clusters are found again from every column on the floor that is not a stub, so a grouping built from the focused column alone (2026-11-09) fails here

folder names: readable or not drawn, at every zoom: from the fit the wheel turns out three steps and in six (over the view's centre, so three more out returns the camera to the fit exactly); at each step no two names overlap or touch (count lines included), none is only dots, none runs past its own folder, none is under the minimum size; at the fit some name is shown (far out on a small window none may fit, and then none is drawn)
